verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group documents itself as an attorney-led immigration firm handling O-1, EB-1 and similar petitions. It states that all work is prepared under attorney supervision and reviewed before submission, and it lists case strategy and legal writers among its services, which implies the firm prepares and files petitions itself. However, the specific end-to-end components are never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence-binder assembly, drafting or sourcing of expert and support letters, form preparation, a description of filing handling, and independent or client corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: all work is done under the close supervision of an attorney and reviewed by an attorney before being submitted
we immediately set a case strategy, identify any issues we foresee, and start work for optimum turn around time

DARYANANI LAW GROUP is a boutique immigration law firm providing first class, attorney-led, personal service tailored to the immigration requirements of foreign nationals and their employers since 1993.
attorneys supported by experienced paralegals, legal writers, and administrative staff
